rules.title: Deceptive Efficacy and Guaranteed Outcomes
rules.text: Content must not guarantee a specific health, cosmetic, financial, or performance result, time-to-result, universal success rate, or permanent outcome without an allowed qualification.
exceptions: Clearly qualified descriptions of possible outcomes that do not promise a result are allowed.

rules.title: Off-Platform Solicitation and Spam
rules.text: Content must not direct users to private or off-platform contact channels, disguised handles, QR destinations, or unsolicited promotional messaging when the active policy prohibits that solicitation.
exceptions: A clearly identified official support channel used only to resolve an existing order is allowed.

rules.title: Fraud, Impersonation, and Credential Theft
rules.text: Content must not facilitate phishing, impersonation, advance-fee fraud, fake prizes, deceptive investment schemes, or attempts to obtain credentials or payment through false pretenses.
exceptions: Fraud prevention and reporting without reusable attack instructions are allowed.

rules.title: Self-Harm and Dangerous Behavior
rules.text: Content must not encourage self-harm, solicit methods, pressure another person to self-injure, or promote dangerous challenges likely to cause serious harm.
exceptions: Recovery, prevention, crisis support, and non-graphic help-seeking content are allowed.

rules.title: Violence, Weapons, and Criminal Facilitation
rules.text: Content must not threaten violence, facilitate weapon misuse, provide actionable criminal instruction, or encourage dangerous wrongdoing.
exceptions: Non-operational news, historical, fictional, safety, and prevention contexts are allowed.

rules.title: Cyber, Privacy, Information, and Agent Safety
rules.text: Content must not facilitate credential theft, unauthorized access, privacy exposure, or coordinated information manipulation; request or attempt system-prompt extraction; expose hidden instructions; or request, attempt, or facilitate safeguard bypass.
exceptions: Defensive, authorized, high-level educational, and remediation contexts are allowed when they do not expose sensitive data or reusable attack steps.

rules.title: Hate, Harassment, and Abusive Targeting
rules.text: Content must not attack a protected class, dehumanize people, direct targeted harassment, or encourage sustained bullying or abusive targeting.
exceptions: Counterspeech, reporting, and moderation are allowed when they do not endorse the abuse.
